mapper.sql: id, type_id, label, dict_value, sort_order, status, is_default, remark, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_item WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM sys_dict_item WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_dict_item WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND dict_value = #{value} AND deleted = 0

SELECT i.id, i.type_id, i.label, i.dict_value, i.sort_order, i.status, i.is_default, i.remark, i.deleted, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM sys_dict_item i JOIN sys_dict_type t ON t.id = i.type_id WHERE t.type_code = #{typeCode} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 1 ORDER BY i.sort_order ASC, i.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_item WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_item (type_id, label, dict_value, sort_order, status, is_default, remark, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{item.typeId}, #{item.label}, #{item.value}, #{item.sortOrder}, #{item.status}, #{item.isDefault}, #{item.remark}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_item SET label = #{item.label}, dict_value = #{item.value}, sort_order = #{item.sortOrder}, status = #{item.status}, is_default = #{item.isDefault}, remark = #{item.remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{item.id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_dict_item SET deleted = id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
